name: Episodic memory size measurement
goal: Measure where episodic memory's ~80 GB goes (index composition, archive composition, archive-vs-original overlap, compressibility, code paths) so the fix design targets the real bulk.

tasks.name: Measure and record
tasks.description: Run human plan Task 1 Steps 1-11 exactly. Read-only: every sqlite3 call -readonly; no modification/deletion in ~/.config/superpowers, ~/.claude, ~/.codex; gzip -c | wc -c only. Logs per step in <SP>/epmem/ with timestamps. Steps 2-3 (dbstat, byte sums via length(CAST(text AS BLOB))) as background Bash runs (timeout 3600000); dbstat unavailable -> record and continue. Step 5 greps indexer.ts, paths.ts, sync.ts, codex-sync.ts, codex-paths.ts, sync-cli.ts and confirms mapping by reading (Claude sync.ts:106-110 non-recursive; Codex codex-sync.ts:30-44,102-107 basename index over ~/.codex/sessions + archived_sessions). Step 6 writes overlap.sh with the Write tool exactly as in the human plan (classes ORIG_SAME_SIZE/ORIG_DIFF_SIZE/ORIG_MISSING/GENERATED/UNMAPPED x kinds claude-session/claude-agent/codex-rollout/generated/nested/unknown). Compressibility on 8 named samples + tool_result sample; grep code paths and confirm by reading. Write docs/reviews/2026-10-07-episodic-memory-size-findings.md with measured numbers and per-candidate-fix savings estimates citing their numbers (unmeasured = UNVERIFIED; note -shm read-marks and unarchived current subagent transcripts); stage with loop docs. No tests required: read-only investigation, no product code.
